title: Airport workers got security badges before TSA completed background checks, watchdog finds
summary: Auditors found that the agency failed to enforce its own screening rules at about 20 airports, allowing some workers to keep active badges for months despite disqualifying security notices.

title: Tough choices, uncertainty, and scrutiny may lie ahead for defense contractors
summary: With a new Congress in 2027, companies could see more anti-corruption probes.

title: Planning behind USDA employee relocations ‘unknown,’ after agency chief rebuffs watchdog’s review
summary: USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins rebuked GAO’s review of the department’s employee relocation plans as “veiled partisan shenanigans.”

title: GSA brings back daily work reports, with threat of disciplinary action
summary: The new requirement calls for Technology Transformation Services staff to detail what they accomplished, what they're working on next and any obstacles they face by 6 p.m. each day.

title: State Department's push to cancel hundreds of contracts left behind a trail of mistakes, watchdog finds
summary: Several government oversight reports have found that agencies made costly operational errors as they implemented the administration’s cost-cutting directives.

title: Walkinshaw to push for federal pay raise in lame duck spending talks
summary: The Northern Virginia congressman also said Thursday that he sees a “path” to restoring federal employees’ collective bargaining rights next year.

title: USDA’s request to lift stay on employee relocations denied by federal judge
summary: USDA’s second-largest component agency sent “corrected” notices telling employees they were not being relocated, after Government Executive reported that it seemingly violated a court order.

title: Justice Department creates new task force to police AI misuse
summary: The group will coordinate the department’s criminal and civil enforcement efforts involving AI and serve as its main link to the White House’s Super Intelligence Force.

title: HHS employees face another painful loss amid a year of workplace trauma
summary: News of a SAMHSA employee’s death has brought on a renewed wave of grief for the HHS workforce, which has faced other traumatic experiences in the workplace.

title: Make these health coverage decisions before you retire
summary: From FEHB eligibility rules to Medicare enrollment deadlines, the right steps before your last day can protect coverage for you and your spouse.

title: These award-winning feds want to advance science for the public good — and challenge stereotypes about government work
summary: The Arthur S. Flemming awards have been around for more than 75 years and generally recognize civil servants who work in scientific fields.

title: Here’s how the Trump administration may face pushback from a Democrat-controlled Congress
summary: A House committee's top Democrat is reminding agency heads to preserve all records, as the party draws up its post-midterms oversight plans.

title: A Democratic Congress could derail major Pentagon plans and put Hegseth under pressure
summary: Funding fights, investigations and potential impeachment proceedings could reshape the Defense Department’s agenda, putting high-profile initiatives such as the Golden Fleet and Autonomous Warfare Command at risk.

title: Post-midterms, federal unions push for pay raise, restoration of bargaining rights
summary: Labor leaders said they are hopeful lawmakers could tackle some priorities in Congress’ "lame duck" session, ahead of Democrats’ formally taking control of both the House and Senate next year.

title: GSA names new acquisition chief after months with acting leader
summary: Jennifer Hill, a former banking executive who joined the agency in February, will lead the Federal Acquisition Service. GSA also named a new head of its public buildings division.

title: IRS workforce issues prominent among watchdog’s FY27 priorities
summary: Even after substantial workforce cuts last year, the IRS's headcount is “consistent with historical staffing” levels. But TIGTA finds these cuts “occurred rapidly and resulted in the departure of many experienced employees.”

title: Trump’s federal workforce overhaul faces a new Congress after Democratic wins
summary: At least one federal employee who separated from the federal government since last year will serve in the House.

title: OPM formally ends FEVS in favor of agency-specific surveys
summary: Federal employees and good government groups warn the promulgation of smaller, shorter surveys means agencies will miss out on important information about the health of their organizations.

title: ‘Exit survey’ of former feds finds fears of civil service politicization under Trump — and many willing to return to their agencies
summary: While the Office of Personnel Management has argued that most of the 2025 federal workforce separations were voluntary, academic researchers countered that many of the departing civil servants reported they felt forced into resigning.

title: USDA asks judge to lift employee relocation stay that ‘significantly hinders’ its operations
summary: The Forest Service says a court's stay prevents it from filling “critical" positions to address wildfires and avalanches. USDA’s research division warns further delays could mean "discontinued employment” for staff.

title: Companies warn cyber threat sharing could suffer without new legal protections
summary: A coalition of 35 industry groups is pressing Congress to extend liability safeguards for businesses that share cyberattack data with federal agencies, with the current stopgap set to expire next month.

title: Most TSP funds decline again in October
summary: Just two of the core portfolios in the federal government’s 401(k)-style retirement savings program finished last month in the black.

title: Musk is the target of a new Democratic bill to curtail political donations from federal contractors
summary: While government contracting companies are already barred from making campaign contributions, a new measure would extend that prohibition to the corporations’ leaders.

title: VA physicians’ and dentists’ association urges pause in new health record system rollouts
summary: The group wants independent patient safety reviews and fixes at facilities already using Oracle Health before VA moves ahead with more deployments.
